AgentViewModel.reason: UI turn lifetime, streaming, confirmation, cancellation and reset move to ChatSession.

ConversationMemoryReducer.reason: ConversationMemoryReducer is nested in AgentSession.kt; typed reducer and session generation replace the legacy memory container.

LiteRtLmChatEngine.reason: The common kernel owns orchestration; the LiteRT gateway owns native conversations and tool replies.

AgentTool.reason: Typed plugin contracts replace the app-local tool interface.

CreateCalendarEventTool.reason: CreateCalendarEventPlugin and Android intent backend own the calendar draft action.

OpenComposeTool.reason: OpenComposePlugin owns compose actions with the common policy/confirmation pipeline.

SearchBusinessCardsTool.reason: Search/get/count are distinct typed plugins; search does not expose channel values.

ToolRegistry.reason: Common registry resolves versioned capability implementations.

CardGazetteer.reason: Field-aware constraints replace the app gazetteer. Department filter bypass and missing company axis found during review are fixed and tested.

CardSearchService.reason: One model-backed retrieval snapshot is shared by chat and directory; presentation recording is separate.

KeywordSearchRanker.reason: Phrase/all/prefix/LIKE candidate tiers and normalized index text live in the Room adapter and shared text utilities.

TextEmbeddingProvider.reason: The native Android embedding engine implements separate query/document task prompts.

HuggingFaceTokenizer.reason: The upstream JVM tokenizer method throws an unwired-runtime exception; the app uses native SentencePiece through the RAG SDK.

InMemoryKeywordCandidateSource.reason: Core in-memory candidate retrieval is used for JVM fixtures; production supplies Room candidates.

KeywordCandidateSource.reason: KeywordRetriever and BusinessCardKeywordIndex are the core/Room candidate boundaries.

LightweightTokenizer.reason: Shared query normalization/tokenization replaces the separate lightweight tokenizer.

NoOpRerankerEngine.reason: Upstream only truncates the candidate list and reports isModelBacked=false. No neural reranker was lost.

RerankerEngine.reason: Upstream compatibility constructor receives this as an unused argument; RRF remains the real ranking path.

RoomFtsKeywordRetriever.reason: Upstream is a TODO returning an empty list; actual Room FTS tiers are implemented by the integrated repository.

SearchExample.reason: The upstream console example is not an Android entry point. CardDirectory and contact plugins expose production retrieval.

SearchMode.reason: Legacy CARD_TAB_KEYWORD/AGENT_HYBRID UI split is not restored: the user requires model-backed retrieval without missing-model keyword fallback.

SqliteFts5KeywordRetriever.reason: Upstream FTS5 class is a TODO returning empty results; Android uses actual Room FTS4.

TextTokenizer.reason: The actual Android native tokenizer replaces the unconnected JVM tokenizer interface.
